name: How long does a typical kitchen upgrade take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen upgrade take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard cosmetic kitchen refresh typically takes 2 to 3 weeks, while a full gut renovation usually spans 4 to 8 weeks. Timelines vary depending on cabinet lead times, whether walls are removed, and the extent of rough-in plumbing or electrical alterations. When your layout stays intact and focus remains on finish carpentry, tile backsplash installation, and interior painting, work moves much quicker. For major layout reconfigurations that involve custom framing or relocating sink lines, owner-operator Abraham Becerra plans and coordinates specialized mechanical sub-trades alongside his crew's finish work to keep phases moving without unnecessary downtime between demo and final punch list.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic updates take 2 to 3 weeks, while full kitchen remodels take 4 to 8 weeks depending on layout changes, cabinet delivery, and rough-in plumbing or electrical requirements.
